title: Developer tooling
outcome: People judge what agents made at the level of the outcome, reviewing ADRs, memories, domains, capabilities and ICE in tools that ship with Garura. Argus comes first.
why: Agents now make more in one run than a pull request can show.
proof: A person reviews a whole run in the tool.
Their answers become part of the work.
must_not: Make people read raw files to know what was made.

touches.title: Ship every change the same way
Open each change where it will land
Commit each change by concern, with its issue named and nothing sensitive
Raise each change for review against where it lands
Merge each change where it lands, on the review's approval and a person's yes
Land a plan's branch on main with evidence that every commit was reviewed
Land several ready issues in one change
Scan every push for client, company and personal references
Keep the docs and command pages in step with each change
